Commentary.Commentary: That's the end of another exciting series! India have ended up winning the game and series but the fight shown by the visitors is commendable. They pushed India to the limit in all the matches but India were simply better in the end. India, now host Sri Lanka for a three match T20I series starting from 5th January while the Calypso Kings go back home to host Ireland starting with the ODIs on 7th January. Until then, cheers.

Indian skipper, Virat Kohli is also the Man of the Match. Kohli says that having finished games so many times he was calm. Tells dew is becoming a factor and one needs just a few partnerships to put the opposition under pressure. Adds that Jadeja took the pressure off him and tells that he was happy to see others (Jadeja and Shardul) finish off the game. On the year, Virat says that it has been a beautiful year and feels apart from the 30 bad minutes of cricket in the World Cup, they have been excellent and adds that they will keep chasing the ICC trophy. On the fast bowling talent India have, Virat says it is a proud moment as India have hardly ever had such potent attacks. Feels that it is the reason they feel they can win games abroad. Says that they will feel proud if they can at least keep the team as strong as before if not make them even stronger. Kohli then goes onto collect the trophy before he is joined by his teammates.

Rohit Sharma is named the Man of the Series. Rohit tells that it was a decider and they wanted to make the most of the track as Cuttack is a good batting wicket. Tells he is sad that he could not continue but tells he enjoyed other performances. Singles out Shardul's pull shot. On the year, he said he has enjoyed it a lot but says winning the World Cup would have been even better but tells he has enjoyed the year personally. Adds that the team has also had a good year and he is happy. Further says that he is not done and is excited for the year to come. Tells that he knows his game and he backed himself. On the red ball cricket, he says he enjoyed it but was also challenging as the ball was moving in India unlike they have seen before.

West Indies skipper, Kieron Pollard says that there was not much to be disappointed about as he is proud from where they have come from. Credits his players for showing the mettle and congratulates the Indian team for winning. Says they are the no.1 side and he is happy that they pushed them to their limits. On being asked about the batting performances, Pollard says that he knew the side had the talent and credits the batters. Singles out a few performances like Hetmyer's, Hope's and Pooran's. Says that they just wanted them to express themselves and tells that there is a lot to look forward to in the future.
Stay tuned for the presentation as we find out who the Man of the Match and Player of the series are.

Early on, West Indies posted a daunting total of 316 in front of the Men in Blue, courtesy Pooran's and Pollard's knocks. They had some vital contributions from Hetmyer, Hope and the rest. This score looked like a good one but the dew might have had an effect on the final result of the game. India bowled well in patches, especially in the middle when they picked up some quick wickets but Pooran and Pollard took the attack to them and in the end reached what looked like a defendable score.

The West Indian bowlers were not upto the mark. They bowled a quite a few loose balls at the start and Rohit and Rahul took full toll of that. Then they changed their lines and lengths helping them make a slight comeback in the match. At one stage, they picked up three quick wickets but needed to pick up more wickets but they could not. Keemo Paul was the pick of the bowlers while the others were disappointing.

Jadeja says he was just thinking that he knew it was a good wicket and the ball came nicely onto the bat so he was very confident. Tells that he told Shardul not to do anything silly as he knew that the pitch was good to bat. Admits there was pressure on him as he hadn't batted much in the series. But tells that Virat told him to play straight as the pitch was good to bat on.

First up, Shardul Thakur. Thakur says that he did not think about Virat Kohli getting out as that would have put him under pressure. All he thought was that there is a set batsmen in the crease. Admits that he has been in such situations in the domestic circuit but says that it was a pleasure to do it in the international stage. On being asked if he is ready to become India's no. 8, Shardul says that he is ready as he thinks he can do the job with the bat as well.
The guys who guided India home towards the end, Shardul Thakur and Ravindra Jadeja are caught down for a quick chat with Harsha Bhogle.

What a match we have had and it is India who come out on top. They have also taken the series 2-1 but it has been a tough fight given by the West Indies. Coming to this chase, India started off brilliantly with Rohit Sharma and KL Rahul who stitched a partnership of 122 runs before Rohit was out. India, after another small partnership between KL Rahul and the Indian skipper lost some vital wickets in the middle. It looked like West Indies would make a comeback but Kohli and Jadeja stitched a valuable 58-run stand to get closer to the target. Kohli fell 15 short of his century and the hosts still required 30 runs off 23 balls  but Shardul Thakur came in and finished things off with a good cameo.

Drama at the end! Safely in but India would not have cared as it is a no ball. India win by 4 wickets. On the pads, Jadeja flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes a quick single. The fielder scores a direct hit at the keeper's end. The umpire takes it upstairs but he has also signaled a no ball as Keemo Paul overstepped. The umpire still checks upstairs and replays show Thakur was in but unsure how it would have mattered. Nonetheless India win by 4 wickets and seal the series.
The umpires have gone upstairs for a run out against Shardul Thakur. It looked close but the umpire signals it a no ball and that is game, set and match. On replays, anyway, Thakur was well in.
Full on middle, Jadeja strokes it to mid on.
Good length ball outside off, Jadeja punches it on the off side and gets a couple. Scores level now.
FOUR! Edgy but India don't care a bit. Slower bouncer around the body, Jadeja looks to pull but it goes off the top edge fine down the leg side for a boundary.

Not Out! Shardul is safely in. Full outside off, Jadeja hits it straight to mid off. Shardul comes out for a single but Jadeja sends him back. Shardul turns and tries to go back but he slips. The throw from the fielder is a poor one and Shardul recovers and makes his ground as Keemo takes the bails off.
Run out appeal taken upstairs. Looks like Shardul is back in.
Back of a length on off, Jadeja pulls it towards deep mid-wicket and gets a single. 15 off the over. Just 7 needed off 12.
On the body, Thakur glances it to the leg side and takes a single. 17 from 6 for Shardul. Who would have thought that he'd be the man to take them so close?
FOUR! Jadeja was the man but Shardul says I am no walkover! Full on middle, Thakur hits it right in the gap between deep mid-wicket and long on for a boundary.

EDGED AND SIX! Bouncer around the body, Thakur looks to pull but gets a top edge. The ball flies and it goes over the square leg fence for a biggie. Jadeja applauds his partner, the dressing room is going wild and the crowd is going bonkers.
WIDE! Bouncer bounces too high. Shardul looks to pull but misses. The square leg umpire signals it as wide to the umpire and it has been wided.
Slower ball on the body, Jadeja pulls it towards short fine leg and takes a single. A bit to the left or right and that would have been a boundary.
Length ball outside off, Jadeja has a slash at it but misses. Better from Sheldon.
WIDE! Slower ball gone wrong. Misses it completely and bowls it well down the leg side. Jadeja does not even offer any shot. The last thing Cottrell would look to bowl is a wide ball.
22 needed off the last 3 overs now. Cottrell to bowl out. If he can get rid of Jadeja in this over then West Indies might feel like they are in with a chance.
On the pads, Jadeja flicks it to fine leg and keeps the strike.
Back of a length around off, Shardul pulls it to long on for a run.
Good length ball around off, Jadeja punches it towards long off for one.
Now guides this one down to third man and gives the strike to Jadeja.

FOUR! Shardul is not bad with the bat in hand and he has proved just that. Full outside off, Shardul lunges forward and creams his drive through covers. And the loudest cheer in the cubical was for this shot.
Shardul Thakur replaces the Indian skipper out in the middle.

OUT! Chopped on! Is this the turning point in this game? Stunned silence in the ground as the skipper walks back 15 short of his century. Keemo Paul strikes on the first ball of his comeback over. The ray of hope, West Indies were looking for. Kohli cannot believe what has happened. Full outside off, Kohli looks to drive away from the body. The ball takes the inside edge and goes on to disturb the stumps. India into the bowlers now. 30 needed in 23, can West Indies pull off a miracle?
Keemo Paul is back on. 8-0-44-2 are his figures so far.
Full delivery on middle, Virat works it to mid-wicket and takes a single. 30 runs required from 24 balls.
Short ball on middle, Jadeja pulls it with disdain in front of square. Pooran runs across and makes a good diving stop. Only a single. Jadeja wanted a double but Kohli sends him back.
Slower delivery on middle, Kohli tucks it to mid-wicket and calls Jadeja for a single.
Short ball on middle, Jadeja pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 33 needed off 27 balls.
FOUR! This is excellent batting! Full delivery outside off, Jadeja thrashes it over the extra cover fielder for a boundary.
BOUNCER! It is bowled around off, Jadeja sways away from it. The umpire signals it one for the over. It should have been as it was way over Jadeja's head.

Full delivery on off, Jadeja drives it to mid off for a single. 50-run stand is up between the two. A much-needed one for India. They had lost some quick wickets and this partnership has steadied the ship.
FOUR! Hammered! Short ball on middle, Jadeja pulls it to deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Short ball on middle, Kohli pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Jadeja comes forward and pushes it to mid off for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Kohli whips it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
BEATEN! Well bowling! Good length ball on off tailing in, Kohli looks to drive it but ball goes between the bat and pad.  Kohli has to keep calm here.
Jason Holder is back into the attack.
Good length ball outside off, Kohli guides this to third man for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Jadeja guides it uppishly to third man for a single. The fielder collects it on the bounce.
Short of a length delivery on middle, Jadeja whips it to mid-wicket where the fielder misfields allowing the batters to take a couple.
Fuller one on middle, Kohli tucks it to the leg side for a single.
Fullish delivery on middle, Jadeja whips it to deep square leg for a single.
Fullish delivery on middle, Kohli whips it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Sheldon Cottrell has a change of ends.
Flatter around off, Kohli dabs it towards third man for one.
FOUR! Excellent wrist work from Kohli. Pierces the gap to perfection. Floated on middle, Kohli flicks it right between long on and deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Now calmly pushes this tossed up ball on off to cover.

FOUR! Smartly played. Shorter outside off, Kohli waits for it and then plays the late cut fine of the man at third man. Roston gives it a chase from third man and he puts in a dive as well but comes second best.
On the pads, Jadeja flicks it to the on side for a single.

The stumps are off. It is a hit wicket. Nope! Shai Hope hit the stumps with his glove. On the body, Jadeja flicks it to short fine leg and the bails comes off the stumps. For a moment it looks like it is a hit wicket but Jadeja's patience shows that it was Hope who dislodged it.
Khary Pierre is back on. His figures read 6-0-36-0.
Around the pads, Jadeja flicks it and gets a single to get through the over.
On the pads, Kohli flicks it through mid-wicket and takes a single. This time Jadeja wants the second but Kohli turns it down.
Length delivery outside off, Kohli taps it to point and looks for a quick run which would have ended in a disastrous run out. Jadeja says no for it.
Length deliver around off, RJ punches it to long on and eases to the other end.
Good length ball outside off, Kohli tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes the first one quickly. He wants the second as well but Jadeja turns it down. 250 comes up with that.
Good length ball on off, Jadeja looks to defend but the ball moves away and it goes towards third man off the outer half of his bat for one.
Jason Holder is back on. 8-0-50-1 are his figures so far.
On the pads, Jadeja tucks it to the on side for one. 11 off the over, a good one for the Indians. 68 needed in 54 balls now. Surely India's game to lose.
The batsman has played it to the point region. They pick up a single.
Shortis on off, Jadeja punches it to the off side for one.
Back of a length on off, VK defends it with soft hands towards point and takes one.

Excellent running but good effort from Cottrell as well. Good length ball outside off. Sheldon takes the pace off it. Jadeja looks to tap it down the off side but it hits him high on the bat. Jaddu looks at Kohli and his skipper calls for a quick run. Cottrell charges towards the ball and tries to show some footballing skill as he attempts to shoot it at the stumps. He kicks it with power but misses the stumps. Had he hit Kohli might have been in trouble.

FIVE WIDES! Poor from Cottrell. He misses his line and bowls it full down the leg side. Jadeja looks to flick but misses. Hope behind the stumps dives but fails to get there and the ball is off to the fence.
Slower ball on middle, Kohli flicks it wide of long on and gets a single.
Powerplay 3 time. 5 fielders can be stationed outside the circle now.
Outside off, Kohli pushes it to third man for another single.
Back of a length ball on middle, Jadeja works it to the deep square leg region for a single.
Good length on middle, Kohli tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, Jadeja guides this through point and takes a single.
On a length outside off, Kohli guides it to third man and picks up a single.
Good length ball on off, Kohli drives it to cover for nothing.

FOUR! Jadeja is off the mark but not in the most convincing manner. Back of a length ball on the body, Jadeja looks to play it but then decides to leave it. The ball hits the inner half of his bat and goes fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Ravindra Jadeja is the new man in. He needs to play a supporting role to Kohli. Can he do it?

OUT! Bowled! What a delivery! Wow! Kedar can do nothing about it. A left-arm bowler making the ball come back in to the right hander is always difficult to deal with. Pacy, full and inswinging ball on off and middle. Kedar looks to play it straight but the ball nips in and goes right between the gap of bat and pad. It goes onto uproot the middle pole. Cottrell brings out his trademark salute and the West Indies players are up in joy. Virat is there at the other end, looking helpless and a bit agitated at Kedar but he could not have done much about it. Half the side back in the dressing room, India need 88 from 67 balls now
Short ball, a slower bouncer. Virat pulls it to deep mid-wicket and eases to the other end.
Length deliver around off, KJ runs it down to third man for one.
Follows the boundary with a single down to cover.
FOUR! Yorker gone wrong and punished well. Cottell attempts a  yorker but misses it and sends a low full toss on the leg side. Kohli flicks it with ease for a boundary.
Sheldon Cottrell is back on. 5-1-22-0 are his figures so far.
Length delivery on off,  KJ defends it from within the crease. 11 off the over, a good one for India. 95 needed off 72 now.

FOUR! Oh that is poor from Holder. He surely should be stopping that. West Indies should not give away such easy runs. Good length ball outside off, Kedar taps it to the right of third man. Holder gets there but he is casual in his approach to getting down. He misses it and the ball goes to the fence.
On the body, VK glances it to the on side for one.
FOUR! Easy, just easy for Kohli. You bowl him on the pads and he will flick you without even looking at it. On the pads, Virat glances it to deep square leg for a boundary.
WIDE! Joseph misses his line and sprays one down the leg side. Kohli looks to flick but misses and it has been wided.
On the pads, Kedar turns it behind square on the leg side for one.
Full and coming back in. Jadhav looks to defend but it hits his pad off the inner half of his bat. It goes to the off side, Kedar looks for a single again but Kohli says no.
Alzarri Joseph is back on.
Good length ball on off, Kohli defends this solidly.
Full delivery on off, Kohli pushes it to covers.
On middle, flicked to the leg side for a single.

FIFTY! 55th one for him in this format! It has been another good innings from the skipper. He needs to continue if India have to win here. Short of a length delivery on middle, Kohli pulls it to deep square leg to get to his milestone. Can he get them to a series victory?
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.

OVERTHROWS! Full delivery on off, Kohli drives it to mid off and takes off for a single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end and misses. The ball rolls to deep square leg and the batters steal another run.

NOT OUT! Jadhav makes it well in by dragging his bat well before he reaches the crease. Good running though. Good length ball on off, Kohli guides it to the wide of the keeper and takes off for a run. Jadhav obliges and runs. Shai Hope collects it and hits the stumps at the keeper's end. The umpire goes up to the third umpire and the replays show that Jadhav had made his way in.
The umpire has gone upstairs for a run out. Kedar Jadhav is the man in question. It looks close to the naked eye. Replays show that Jadhav was well in. Brilliant running.
On a length outside off, Jadhav plays it to third man and takes a single.
Nice shot but finds the fielder! Short of a length ball on middle, Kohli pulls it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Good length ball on middle, Jadhav gets off the mark by flicking this one to mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish delivery on off, Jadhav defends it to mid off.
Full delivery on middle, Kohli flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Kedar Jadhav replaces Rishabh Pant out in the middle.

OUT! BOWLED! Pant goes and now it depends more on Kohli to take India home. West Indies are coming back into this game very strongly. Slower delivery outside off, Pant looks to drive it but hits the inside edge and goes onto hitting the stumps. India are 4 down and  they still require 115 runs to win off 15 overs.
Fuller in length outside off, Pant drives it to mid off.
Slower short ball on middle, Kohli pulls it to deep square leg and gives Pant the strike.
Fullish around off, Kohli drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Good length ball on off, Kohli pushes it to cover-point and takes a single. 200 up for India. Still need 116 runs.
FOUR! Poor bowling from Paul! Drifts this down the leg side, Pant works it to fine leg and picks up his first boundary of the game.
BOUNCER! It is bowled around leg, Kohli ducks under it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Brilliant, just brilliant. This is Kohli at his best. Full delivery on off, Kohli leans forward and thrashes the drive through mid off for another one of his sumptuous boundaries.
Full delivery outside off, Pant drives it but the mid off fielder slides again and stops it. A single taken.
Good length ball on off, Kohli guides it to third man for a single.
Nicely played! Full delivery outside off, Pant drives this crisply to cover but Pollard dives and makes a half stop. The batters manage to take a single.
Jason Holder is back on. 6-0-38-1, his numbers so far.
Full delivery on middle, Kohli flicks it but finds the mid-wicket fielder. No run.
Short of a length ball on middle, Kohli pulls it to mid-wicket.
Good length ball on off, Kohli defends it to point.
Rishabh Pant is the new man in.

Drinks Break! Well...well...well. 128 needed in 105 balls and the match is quite in balance. The match has suddenly jumped to life. India are still on top as they have their skipper and chase master, Virat Kohli out in the middle. He will be joined by a new batsman soon. The required rate is 7.31 so West Indies will know if they can get rid of Kohli then they will be on top.

OUT! CAUGHT! Iyer has to go and that is an excellent catch from Alzarri Joseph. Now the match has suddenly turned. Two quick wickets has pegged India on the back foot. Short of a length ball on middle, Iyer pulls it but finds Alzarri Joseph at deep square leg. Joseph runs forward, slides forward and takes a brilliant catch. Iyer asks the umpire whether the catch was clean and the umpire sends him on his way. The replays confirm that it was a clean catch. India still needed 128 from 105 balls.

FOUR! EDGY! Short of a length ball outside off, Iyer makes room for himself and looks to cut it but it goes off the top edge towards third man. Chase runs across from third man and tries to slide but fails to do so. It slides into the fence.
BOUNCER! It is bowled around middle but does not bounce as much. Iyer ducks under it and it goes on the bounce to the keeper.
Keemo Paul replaces Roston Chase.
Iyer pushes this length ball on off to third man.
Good length ball on off, Kohli guides it to third man and picks up a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Joseph is not learning at all. Short of a length ball on middle, Kohli camps back and hammers the pull to deep mid-wicket for another into the fence.

FOUR! Hammered! Thrashed! Short ball outside off, Kohli pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. It went fast and nobody moved. The required run rate is above 7 and Kohli looks settled out there. Dangerous signs for the visitors.
Short of a length ball on middle, Iyer flick it to fine leg for a single.
Good length delivery on the pads, Kohli flicks it to fine leg and picks up a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Flighted ball outside off, Kohli drives it through extra cover and picks up a couple before the fielder can come across and clean it up.
Floated ball on middle, Kohli plays it back to the bowler.
Outside off, pushed to cover.
Shorter delivery outside off, Iyer punches it to deep cover and takes a single. Iyer is off the mark.
Full delivery on middle, Kohli whips it to long on for a single.
Back of a length ball on middle, Iyer defends it back to the bowler.
Shreyas Iyer joins his skipper out in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rahul goes after playing another terrific innings! Had a great chance to score back-to-back tons but he misses out. Joseph bowls a short of a length ball on middle and leg, Rahul looks to pull it but it hits the gloves and goes up in the air. Shai Hope settles himself under it near short fine leg and takes a simple catch.
BOUNCER! It is bowled outside off, Rahul lets it go to the keeper.
Short ball on middle, Kohli pulls it to deep mid-wicket and picks up a single.
On a length on off, Rahul guides it to the left of the point fielder and calls Kohli for a single.
Short of a length delivery on off, Rahul stands tall and defends it to cover.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Kohli whips this full delivery on middle to long on for a single.
Loopy ball on off, Kohli defends it out.
Flatter delivery outside off, Kohli pushes it to cover.
Shorter delivery outside off, Kohli punches it off the back foot to deep cover. The fielder comes across and cleans up. The batters take two.
Starts with a full delivery on middle, Kohli looks to flick it but it goes off the leading edge back to the bowler.
Roston Chase is back into the attack. 2-0-10-0, his figures so far.
Back of a length ball on off, Rahul cuts it to point.

SIX! What a shot from Rahul! This is excellent batting from Rahul. Full delivery on middle, Rahul beautifully flicks it uppishly over the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum. Probably the shot of the match.
Good length ball outside off, Kohli guides it to third man for a single.
Fullish delivery outside off, Rahul drives it to deep cover for a single.
On a length on middle, Rahul tucks it to mid-wicket.
Starts with a short ball on middle, Kohli pulls it in front of square for a single.
Alzarri Joseph is back on.  3-0-14-0, his numbers so far.
Outside off, guided to third man for another single.
FOUR! Slapped! It is lovely to see when Kohli plays these kind of shots! Short of a length outside off, Virat hops and thrashes it through the covers for a boundary. 150 up for India.
On a length on off, Rahul looks to flick it but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls to point and the batters take a single.
Short of a length ball outside off, Kohli guides it to third man for a single.
Full delivery on off, Kohli drives but finds the cover fielder.
OHH! Short of a length ball outside off, Kohli looks to pull it but misses it.
Short delivery on middle, Kohli pulls it to deep mid-wicket and will keep the strike for the next over.
Full delivery on middle, Rahul plays it to mid on and calls Kohli for a quick single.
Short of a length outside off, Rahul pushes it to point.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kohli punches it to deep cover and crosses over for another single.
Full delivery on off, Kohli pushes it to mid off for nothing.
Short ball on middle, Rahul rocks on his back foot and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Kohli looks to defend it but misses to get hit high on the pads. No appeal as it was probably going above the stumps.
Short ball outside off, Kohli sways away from it.
Short ball on middle, Rahul pulls it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Back of a length outside off, Rahul punches it to point.
On a length outside off, Rahul pushes it to cover for nothing.
Good length ball on middle, Kohli runs it to point for a single.
Keemo Paul is back on. 3-0-21-0, his numbers so far.
Short ball on middle, Rahul defends it out onto the pitch off the back foot.
On off, pushed to deep cover for a single.

FOUR! Delicious! Kohli brings out hsi trademark drive. A half-volley outside off, Kohli leans forward and creams the drive wide of the mid off fielder for a boundary. First one for him in this innings.
Short ball outside off, Rahul punches it beautifully off the back foot to deep cover for a single.
EDGY! Good length ball on the middle stump line, Kohli looks to flick it but gets a leading edge on it which goes towards deep cover. A single taken.
Full delivery on off, Kohli drives it to the cover fielder. He fumbles but no extra run taken.
On the pads, VK flicks it to mid-wicket and keeps the strike.
Flatter on off, Rahul strokes it to point for one.
On the pads, Rahul sweeps it but cannot go past short fine leg.
Short and wide outside off, Virat cuts it but there is a man in the deep so just a single.
Comes down the track and nudges it to long off for one.

FOUR! Very good shot but poor from substitute Hayden Walsh. Flighted on off, Rahul drives it by using his wrist to the left of cover. Walsh there fails to get down in time and the ball goes past him to the fence.
Good length ball on off, Kohli looks to play it on the off side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Around the pads, Rahul flicks it to the leg side for a run.
Length ball on off, Rahul plays it to point.
Kohli is off the mark straightaway. Back of a length ball outside off, Virat cuts it towards deep point and gets underway.
A huge cheer from the crowd as the Indian skipper walks out to bat.

OUT! Caught! West Indies needed a wicket, the question was where it is coming from? The answer is Jason Holder. A lose shot from Rohit. His feet never moved and he would be very disappointed with it. Good length delivery outside off, the ball moves just a tad. Rohit takes it too lethargically and looks to drive with little to no foot movement. The ball takes the outside edge and goes straight into the gloves of Hope. Much needed breakthrough for the visitors. Can they use this as a springboard and get back in this game?
Good length ball on off, Rahul defends it with soft hands and takes a single as the ball goes to the off side.
Bowling change. Jason Holder is back on. West Indies need a wicket but where is it coming from?
FOUR! Easily done. Tossed up on off, Rohit gets down on one knee and sweeps it from the middle of his bat over backward square leg for a boundary.
Shorter on off, RS punches it to cover.
Flatter on off, Rahul taps it to point and eases to the other end.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Floated on the body, Rahul comes down the track and glances it to the on side for a run.

In the air....but safe. Lewis had time to go for it but he decides not to attack the ball. Floated on off, Rohit gets down on one knee and goes for a slog sweep. He does not time it well and hits it high in the air. Lewis in the deep loses the ball in the light and he hangs back to take it on a bounce.
On the body, RS pulls it to deep backward square leg and keeps the strike.
Short ball and this time Rahull pulls it with control towards backward square leg for a run.
Back of a length around off, Rahul looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls towards point but they don't take a run.
Fuller on off, Rahul flicks it to mid-wicket and comes out for a single but Rohit sends him back early. Good call there is no need to take any suicidal run here.
Back of a length outside off, Rohit guides it towards third man and strolls to the other end.
Fuller on middle and off, Rahul flicks it to long on for a run.
Floats this one up outside off, Rahul comes down the track and drives it to deep cover for a single.
Loopy delivery outside off, Rahul pushes it to cover.
Flatter delivery on off, Rohit looks to defend it but it hits the inside half of the bat and goes towards square leg. A single taken.
On middle, defended out.
FOUR! This is brilliant batting from Sharma. Pierre bowls a flighted delivery outside off, Sharma drives it past the diving cover fielder and into the fence.
Floated delivery at 85.1 kph, Sharma works it to mid-wicket.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Rahul works it to mid-wicket.
On off, pushed to cover for nothing.
Short ball on middle, Rahul pulls it to mid-wicket.

FIFTY! The Hitman continues his golden run in 2019. 43rd fifty in ODIs. The opener has made the opening spot his own since he started opening in 2013. Full delivery on middle, Sharma pushes it to long on and takes a single to get to his milestone.
Full delivery on middle, Rohit defends it back to the bowler.
On a length on middle, Rohit tucks it to mid-wicket.

Drinks Break! India are motoring along nicely in this chase. They have reached 102 in 17 overs and have hardly broken a sweat. The openers are once again looking set for a big one. West Indies need to find a way to break this partnership because at the moment they are lacking intensity and that cutting edge.
Floated ball on middle, Rahul plays it back to the bowler.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Around the pads, Rahul turns it to the short fine leg fielder.
Full delivery on middle and leg, Rahul looks to sweep it but gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls to short fine leg. No run.
Shorter one outside off, Sharma plays the cut to deep point for a single.

FIFTY! 5th one for Rahul in ODIs. This has been a top knock from the opener. Continues his good form. He will look to score a big one here and get his side home. He gets there by flicking this flighted ball to the leg side for a single.

Full delivery outside off, Rahul pushes it to deep cover and takes a single. 100-run stand is up between the two. Brillaint batting. They are going at a very good pace and it is easy going for India at the moment.
EDGY FOUR! Short ball aimed at his body, Rahul looks to play the pull it but it goes off the top edge past the keeper into the fence.
Fullish delivery on off, Rahul pushes it to point.
Poor ball but gets away with it! Good length ball on the pads, Rohit flicks it away but finds the deep square leg fielder. A single taken.
Back of a length ball on middle, Rahul tucks it to deep square leg and takes a single.
WIDE! Bouncer bowled down the leg side, Rahul looks to pull it but misses it. The umpire signals a wide.
Good length ball on middle, Sharma works it to deep square leg for a single. Rohit thinks of a second but it is not there.
Alzarri Joseph is into the attack.
Tosses this one up on middle, Rohit pushes it to long on and keeps strike for the next over.
Loopy ball on middle, Rohit looks to defend it but it goes off the inside edge to the leg side.
Tossed up on off, Rahul leans forward and pushes it to deep cover for another run.
Flighted delivery on middle, pushed to long on for a single.
Loopy ball on middle, Rohit defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Very rarely you see Sharma playing the sweep shot. Pierre bowls a full delivery on the pads, Rohit sweeps it to fine leg for a boundary.
Floated ball on middle, Rahul works it to mid-wicket.
Outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
OHH! Chase bowls a flat one outisde off, Rahul looks to punch it off the back foot but gets an inside edge which goes towards square leg. No run.
Floated ball on middle and leg, Sharma flicks it to mid-wicket and crosses over for a single.
Flatter delivery on middle, Sharma defends it back to the bowler.
Tossed up ball on middle, Rahul pushes this down to long on and takes a single.
On off, pushed to long off and Rahul will keep strike for the next over.
Floated delivery on the pads, Rohit tucks it to square leg and picks up a single.
Fullish ball on off, Rahul drives it to long off for a single.
Flighted ball on middle, Rahul defends it back to the bowler.
Floats one one on middle, Rohit milks it to long on and gets to the other end.
Khary starts with a shorter ball around off, Rahul punches it through covers for one.
Khary Pierre is on as well.
Flatter delivery on middle, Rahul punches it off the back foot to long on for a single.
Fullish delivery on off, Sharma drives it to long off and takes a single.
On middle, Rahul flicks this to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Poor bowling this from Chase! Shorter delivery outside off, Rahul cuts it through the point region for a boundary.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.

STUMPING MISSED! It looked close but Hope has made a mess of it. Flighted ball outside off, Rohit leans forward to drive but misses it. Shai fails to collect it cleanly and it rolls to the leg side. Replays show that Rohit had his leg up in the air. A golden opportunity to get back in the game goes abegging.
Time for some spin. Roston Chase is on now.
LEG BYES!Good length ball on middle and leg, Rahul attempts to flick it but it goes off the pads to the leg side. Two leg byes taken.
On middle, Sharma flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, Rahul pushes it to point for a single.
BOUNCER! It is bowled around off stump, Rahul sways away from it.

MISFIELD! Good length ball on middle, Rahul tucks it to backward square leg where Alzarri Joseph comes across but lets the ball through. The ball does not go for the boundary as it hits the legs. He cleans it up but by that time, the batters take a couple.
FOUR! Terrific! Sumptuous! A half-volley from Paul on off, Rahul leans forward and thrashes the drive through mid off for a boundary.
Powerplay 2 signaled by the umpire. Now 4 fielders can be outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over!
On middle, blocked out. India 59/0 at the end of Powerplay1. West Indies at the same stage were 44/0.
How did that stay low? Short ball on middle which kept very low, Sharma gets his bat down in time and does well to defend it back to the bowler.
Good length outside off, Rahul cuts it towards point where it ricochets off Pierre's legs allowing the batters to take a single.
Good length ball outside off, Rahul pushes it to point.
On middle, flicked to square leg for a single.

FOUR! Brilliant shot from the Hitman. Back of a length delivery on off, Sharma rocks on his back foot and cuts it through point for a boundary. The fielder from third man tries to come across but fails to get there.
Full delivery on middle, Sharma defends it to the square leg region for a single.
On off, Sharma defends it back to the bowler.
Full delivery on middle, Rohit flicks it to mid-wicket.
On a length on middle, Rahul works it to the leg side for a single.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Rahul looks to flick it but misses to get hit on the pads. No appeal though.

What has happened there? Keemo Paul steams in and delivers the ball, Rahul looks to play but then pulls out. Pollard has a word with the umpire because he thinks that Rahul tried to play but the umpire thinks it is a dead ball.

FOUR! Poor, poor stuff from Paul! Cannot drift on the pads to any of these batsman. Full delivery down the leg side, Rahul whips it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary. Just like the West Indian openers, this Indian pair has also stitched a 50-run stand. It has come in quicker time too.
Good length ball outside off, Rahul guides it to third man for a single.
Full one on middle, Rahul plays it back to the bowler.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
BEATEN! Short ball on off, Rahul looks to play the upper cut but misses it.
Sharma flicks this length ball to the leg side and picks up a single.
Good fielding! Good length ball outside off, Rohit launches this over cover and it seems that it will go for a boundary but Khary Pierre hares after it and makes a good sliding stop. 2 taken.
Cottrell is back from the other end.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! This is poor fielding from Chase! Have to do a lot better there. Another full on middle and leg, Rahul works it nicely wide of mid on where Chase is stationed. He bends but allows the ball to go through into the fence.
Fullish ball on the pads, Rahul works it away nicely to the deep mid-wicket region for a couple. The fielder comes across and cleans it up.
Full delivery on middle, Rahul whips it to mid on.
Fullish delivery on off, Rahul defends it to cover.
Paul bowls a length delivery on middle, Rohit works it to deep square leg and crosses over for a single.
Good length ball on off, Sharma defends it to point.
Keemo Paul is into the attack.
On middle, defended solidly by Rahul to mid off. 10 runs have come Holder's third over.
FOUR! Brilliant timing!  On a length outside off, Rahul punches it through covers and past the diving Khary Pierre. It races away to the fence.
On middle, Sharma works it to square leg and takes a single.
FOUR! Cannot bowl that line when the fine leg fielder is up in the circle. Good length on the pads, Sharma just helps it on is way towards the deep square leg region for a boundary.
Back of a length ball around off, RS pushes it to cover.
EDGED! Holder bowls a length ball on off, Rahul looks to defend it but hits the outside edge and goes towards third man. A single taken.
Slower delivery outside off, Sharma attempts to defend it but takes the outside edge back to the keeper. Hope dives forward but the ball falls short.
Sharma solidly defends this good length ball back to the bowler.
BEATEN! Nicely bowled! Sheldon bowls a good length outside off, Sharma looks to defend it but the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
On a length on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Good length ball on off, Rahul punches it to cover and calls a loud  no.
Length delivery on off, Rahul gets behind the line and blocks it.
Good length ball on off, Rohit defends it back to the bowler. 10 off the over. Good one for India.
Dot, six, dot, four. So what comes next? Another dot. He is toying with the West Indies players here as once again he does not disturb this length ball outside off.

FOUR! The sound that made off the bat was enough to tell you how perfectly he hit it. Good length ball outside off, Rohit punches it like a Mohammad Ali punch through covers for a boundary. If he was hitting someone in a boxing match that would be a KO.
Now shows sensibility and leaves this ball outside off alone.
SIX! Don't even bother looking that has gone way over the fence. Rohit moves away from the stump and pulls this length ball way over the cow corner fence for a biggie. That is a crowd catch.
On a length outside off, Rohit is in no hurry and he offers a good leave.
On the pads, Rahul glances it to the man on the on side.
Length ball on off, Rahul strokes it through backward point and gets a couple as Hetmyer from third man cleans it up.

Good length ball on off, it shapes away a bit. Rohit looks to defend but the ball goes off the outer half of his bat and it goes towards third man for a single. Rohit equals Jayasuriya's record for most runs in a calendar year in international cricket.
FOUR! Excellent use of the feet. Rohit comes down the track and takes this ball on the up. It is away from him but he keeps his balance and slashes it through covers for a boundary.
Now calmly lets this length ball outside off to carry to the keeper.
FOUR! Rohit is off the mark with a boundary just like his partner. A low full toss on off, Rohit shows great wrist work and flicks it right between mid-wicket and mid on for a boundary.
On off, Rahul blocks it to get through the over. Good comeback from Holder after a poor ball first up.
Good length delivery around middle and leg. Rahul gets behind the line of the ball and blocks it.
Around the pads, Rahul glances it to the on side.

If you could make out how confident a batter is then a good solid defense shows it and this one shows that Rahul is in good form. Fuller around off, KL defends it off the front foot from right of the middle of his bat and shouts a loud no.
Much better from Cottrell. Good length ball around off, Rahul defends it with a straight bat off his back foot.

FOUR! Rahul is off the mark and so are India. Poor ball from Holder to begin. It is a hit-me ball from Jason. It is on the pads, Rahul is in good touch and he says thank you very much as he elegantly flicks it over square leg for a boundary.
Jason Holder will bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Good, solid start from Cottrell. He starts with a maiden. Back of a length on off, Rohit defends it to get through the first.
Very good shot but straight to the fielder. Full around off, Rohit drives it right off the meat but straight to Pollard at cover.
Length ball outside off, Rohit lets it carry to the keeper. No swing for Cottrell so far.
Full on off, Rohit pushes it back to the left of Cottrell. Rahul was out but as he sees the ball has come straight back, he dives back in.
Cottrell goes full now and asks Rohit to go for a drive. He goes half heartedly at it but misses.
Cottrell starts with a good length ball on off, Rohit defends it to point for nothing.

The run chase is all set to begin! India need 316 runs to win. Rohit Sharma and KL Rahul walk out to the middle along with the West Indian players. Sheldon Cottrell will open the bowling for the visitors.
